entries.summary: 12real ESP32-S3/MPU6050 four-second trials,47798samples reverified. Direct/FIFO payload medians451us; successful services603/780us. Same400kHz,8g,500dps,DLPF0,divider7. Raw source is a separate motor-disabled harness, not production main.cpp.

39injected2500us pauses per stressed trial. Direct3925records versus roughly4003unpaused; FIFO4002-4003with peak3packets. Both have approximately3.6ms read-completion gaps. Throughput preservation is not a fresh1kHz control deadline pass.
No external DRDY/motion timing or exact direct physical-sample-loss count; packet-age estimate is nominal only. No BLE/PID/motor load tested and no production acquisition switch accepted.

User confirmed COM3 as target when it was found instead of guessed COM4 and explicitly authorized building/installing the benchmark. Original16MB flash backup retained privately. Board left running motor-disabled benchmark.
